content.text: For all the curious children of Kampala who see wonder in everyday life.

text_lines: Kato spots 1 red boda-boda, rushing down the street.
It zips past the market with a friendly... PII-PII!
Look! 2 blue lorries with a heavy, heavy load.
They carry sweet matooke down the dusty road.
3 yellow diggers are working on the ground.
They scoop up the red soil—what a noisy sound! SCOOP, SCOOP!
4 green garbage trucks, keeping the city clean.
They have the biggest hungry tummies you have ever seen! CRUNCH, CRUNCH!
5 orange cement mixers, turning round and round.
They spin and they mix with a whirring, stirring sound. WHIRR, WHIRR!
6 strong breakdown trucks, coming to the rescue.
If your car is stuck in mud, they will pull it out for you! VROOOM!
7 water trucks are driving to the town.
Bringing cool, fresh water, splashing up and down. SPLISH, SPLASH!
8 timber trucks, moving logs so big and brown.
They rumble from the forest all the way to town. RUMBLE, RUMBLE!
9 shiny car carriers, in a long and straight line.
Carrying brand new cars that look so bright and fine. HONK, HONK!
10 colorful taxis, waiting in the park.
"Mbi, mbi! Let’s go!" they call before it gets too dark.

pages.image_suggestion: Kato standing with Jjajja, looking at the sunset over the city.
text_lines: What a busy day in Kampala! Kato counted them all.
Red, blue, green, and yellow. Big trucks, fast trucks, and loud trucks.

pages.image_suggestion: Kato playing on the floor with his own toy truck, or tucked in bed.
text_lines: Now the busy trucks are going to sleep... and so is Kato.
Goodnight, Kato. Goodnight, trucks.
Shhhhhh...

content.headline: Count the Roar of Kampala!
content.body_text:
Join little Kato on a vibrant adventure through the bustling streets of Kampala. From the speedy pii-pii of the boda-bodas to the heavy rumble of the timber trucks, there is so much to see!

Designed for children ages 3-5, Kato's Truck Count combines early number learning with the sights and sounds of East Africa.
bullet_points: Learn to Count: Follow the numbers 1 to 10.
Practice Writing: Includes traceable numbers on every page.
Discover Vehicles: Learn the names of local trucks and machines.
content.tagline: A perfect read-aloud for curious little minds.
